description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Marketing' in the Opencart admin module, providing CRUD operations for marketing records in the database. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving marketing data and reports.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Model class for managing marketing entries in the database within the Opencart admin system.

methods.name: addMarketing
methods.description: Creates a new marketing record in the database using provided data, returns the new record's primary key.

methods.name: editMarketing
methods.description: Updates an existing marketing record identified by marketing_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteMarketing
methods.description: Deletes a marketing record and its associated reports from the database.

methods.name: getMarketing
methods.description: Retrieves a marketing record based on marketing_id.

methods.name: getMarketingByCode
methods.description: Fetches a marketing record corresponding to a given code.

methods.name: getMarketings
methods.description: Retrieves a list of marketing records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalMarketings
methods.description: Returns the total count of marketing records matching optional filters.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all reports associated with a specific marketing record.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Fetches a list of reports for a specific marketing record, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Counts total reports associated with a specific marketing record.
